name: Montréal-Trudeau International Airport

curfew.v: Open 24 hours for propeller aircraft and jets under 45,000 kg. Jets over 45,000 kg: take-offs only 07:00-midnight and landings only 07:00-01:00 local; ADM may grant exemptions only for medical emergencies, delays beyond the carrier's control, bad weather and some scheduled flights. Window shown is for jets over 45,000 kg (e.g. large-cabin jets); smaller jets have no night limit
curfew.quote: YUL Montréal-Trudeau est ouvert 24 heures par jour pour les avions à hélices et les jets de moins de 45 000 kilogrammes. ... les heures normales d’exploitation sont de 7h00 à minuit pour les décollages ... de 7h00 à 1h00 pour les atterrissages.

hours.v: Airport open 24 hours for propeller aircraft and jets under 45,000 kg MTOW

notes: Night rules from ADM's noise management action plan page (admtl.com/fr/consultation, 'Opérations nocturnes'; plan of 2019, last update February 2022). The curfew window 00:00-07:00 applies to jets over 45,000 kg (landings allowed until 01:00); jets under 45,000 kg and props may operate 24 hours. 1 Nov 2026: added curfew and hours.
